skill.name: webask-quiz-copy
skill.description: Переписывает тексты опроса WebAsk так, чтобы его дочитывали до конца: формулировки вопросов, подписи кнопок, приветствие и благодарность. Применяется, когда человек просит улучшить опрос, сделать его понятнее или жалуется, что анкету не дочитывают.
skill.summary: Improve WebAsk survey wording using abandonment data, with approval before saving changes.
skill.author: webaskio

content.value_statement: Unclear questions and vague introductions can discourage survey completion. This skill uses available abandonment data to prioritize clearer wording and requests approval before saving changes.
actual_capabilities: Use incomplete-response reports to prioritize questions where respondents leave.
Read survey text and structure through WebAsk MCP tools.
Propose clearer, neutral wording for jargon, double negatives, and leading questions.
Rewrite introductions to explain the survey topic, expected duration, and respondent benefit.
Improve button labels and thank-you messages with clear next steps.
Present before-and-after changes and save approved edits through WebAsk update tools.
limitations: Reading and saving WebAsk surveys requires access to the declared MCP tools.
Without response data, recommendations follow general writing principles rather than observed abandonment patterns.
The workflow excludes adding or removing questions and requires preserving question meaning.
Changes cannot guarantee higher completion rates and may affect comparability in surveys already collecting responses.

use_cases.title: Clarify customer feedback questions
use_cases.description: Replace jargon and leading wording with direct questions while preserving the intended meaning.

use_cases.title: Investigate survey abandonment
use_cases.description: Use incomplete-response reports to prioritize wording changes at questions where participants leave.

use_cases.title: Prepare survey text for client review
use_cases.description: Present proposed introduction, button, and thank-you revisions before requesting approval to save them.

prompt_templates.title: Simplify one question
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this survey question in plain language: [question]. Preserve its meaning and show the original beside your proposed wording.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: improve a supplied question without editing a live survey.

prompt_templates.title: Revise the opening screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the introduction for WebAsk survey [survey]. The audience is [audience], the duration is [duration], and the purpose is [purpose]. Show proposed text before saving.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: make the first screen clear for a specific audience.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize abandonment points
prompt_templates.prompt: Review incomplete responses for WebAsk survey [survey]. Prioritize questions where people leave and propose clearer wording in [language]. Explain when data is unavailable. Wait for approval before saving.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use available response data to guide revisions.

prompt_templates.title: Review an active survey
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit copy in active WebAsk survey [survey] for [audience]. Review abandonment reports, questions, introduction, buttons, and thank-you text. Preserve meaning and flag comparability risks. Show before-and-after proposals without adding or removing questions. Save only changes I explicitly approve.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate a data-informed review with approval and comparability safeguards.

output_examples.input: Simplify: Please assess your degree of satisfaction with the quality of services provided.
output: Before: Please assess your degree of satisfaction with the quality of services provided.
After: How satisfied are you with the quality of the service?
Reason: Removes formal wording while preserving the focus on service quality.
Status: Proposed wording only; no changes saved.

output_examples.input: Improve the introduction for a three-question visit survey lasting one minute. Responses will help reduce queues.
output: Proposed introduction: Answer three questions about your visit. This takes about one minute. Your answers will help us reduce queues.

best_practices: Provide the survey identifier, audience language, purpose, and verified duration before requesting revisions.
Use abandonment reports when available and label recommendations based only on general writing principles.
Review proposed changes, preserve question meaning, and consider response comparability before approving updates.
anti_patterns: Rewriting all survey text without showing proposals and obtaining approval.
Changing question meaning or silently editing a survey that is already collecting responses.
Adding or removing questions, or treating copy changes as proof of improved completion.

faq.question: What does this skill rewrite?
faq.answer: It revises survey questions, introductions, button labels, and thank-you messages in WebAsk.

faq.question: Does it save changes automatically?
faq.answer: The instructions require showing proposed changes and waiting for approval before saving.

faq.question: Can it help before responses arrive?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses general writing principles and must explain that response data is not yet available.

faq.question: Which language does it use?
faq.answer: It replies in your language and writes survey text in the language of your audience.

faq.question: Which tools does it require?
faq.answer: It declares five WebAsk MCP tools: get_quiz_report, get_quiz_structure, get_quiz_texts, update_quiz_texts, and update_quiz_widgets.

faq.question: Can it edit a survey that is already collecting responses?
faq.answer: It must warn that wording changes can affect response comparability and obtain approval before saving.
